llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.Pinch() and Gesture.Pan() are composed with Gesture.Simultaneous(pinchGesture, panGesture) from react-native-gesture-handler.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must store zoom and translation in Reanimated shared values (`scale`, `translateX`, `translateY`) and apply them through `useAnimatedStyle` transform.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: scale, translateX, translateY are useSharedValue instances and all three are applied in useAnimatedStyle via the transform array.
evidence: useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ transform: [{ scale: scale.value }, { translateX: translateX.value }, { translateY: translateY.value }] }))

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must clamp zoom using the existing `MIN_SCALE` constant inside `Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate(...)`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: MIN_SCALE is used as the lower bound inside Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate via clamp(scale.value * e.scale, MIN_SCALE, MAX_SCALE).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must clamp zoom using the existing `MAX_SCALE` constant inside `Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate(...)`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: MAX_SCALE is used as the upper bound inside Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate via clamp(scale.value * e.scale, MIN_SCALE, MAX_SCALE).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use the existing `VIEWPORT_SIZE` to constrain movement while zoomed inside `Gesture.Pan().onUpdate(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: VIEWPORT_SIZE is used inside Gesture.Pan().onUpdate to compute the max translation bound: (scale.value - 1) * VIEWPORT_SIZE / 2.
